title: Floral Print Jacquard V-Neck Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elegant and timeless, this floral jacquard midi dress blends classic tailoring with a refined textured finish. The V-neckline, fitted bodice and full A-line skirt create a flattering silhouette that feels polished from every angle. A beautiful choice for wedding guests, garden weddings, rehearsal dinners, bridal showers, cocktail parties, afternoon receptions and mother of the bride celebrations.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises jacquard.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
